script_text: Stop, Aquarius — Mars in your sign is picking a fight with Saturn today. The red planet storms through your 1st House of Self, squaring the taskmaster in your 3rd House of Communication, and your ruling planet Uranus watches from the 5th House of Romance like a chaotic referee. This air-sign tension means your words cut sharper than you intend, especially before noon. In love, Uranus in Gemini trines Mars, so a sudden flirtation or volatile exchange with a lover could rewrite the script by sunset — singles, wear something unconventional. Career-wise, Saturn's grip on your 3rd House demands precision in contracts or pitches; don't sign anything until Mercury clears its shadow tomorrow. Warning: avoid heated debates with siblings or neighbors — they'll spiral fast. Blessing: a flash of genius strikes during your morning walk — write it down. Subscribe so you don't miss Thursday's Jupiter shift into your 7th House.
